title: Expected runtime of the mismatch procedure
statement: Let $p:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be an infinite Boolean sequence. On a finite input string, compare its bits with the corresponding initial terms of $p$; halt at the first mismatch and return the corresponding term of $p$, and do not halt if there is no mismatch. For every finite cutoff $K$, the sum of the probabilities that this procedure has not halted after $s$ bits, over $0\le s<K$, is at most $2$.
